turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are things with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm working in the office three days a week again, and I need to sort out my dog during the day.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll tell you all the choices first. Wait until I'm finished before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's a doggy daycare near work, he'd play with other dogs all day, but it's pricey and he can be shy.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A dog walker could come at lunch for an hour, much cheaper, but he'd be home alone the rest of the time.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or my retired neighbour offered to have him at her place, free, though she's not that strong on a lead.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's all I've got. Which would you choose?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: If he's shy, a whole day at daycare might be a lot for him at first. The lunchtime walker is a good middle ground if he's okay napping alone. The neighbour is lovely and free, but a strong puller and a not so strong walker is a worry.
